title: Semantic animation and panel boundaries
objective: Implement immutable bounded PlotSpec animation frames with deterministic Plotly controls, explicit resource and export capability boundaries, and validated reuse of PanelComposition2D

oracles: CPython and Sage.js differential JSON witnesses
Plotly.js browser validation and Chromium smoke

handoff.summary: Commit 47f13fcb implements immutable, JSON-safe PlotAnimation and AnimationFrame states for PlotSpec and the existing PanelComposition2D, stable qualified layer identity, exact topology validation, hard frame/panel/layer/sample/payload/duration limits, validated timing and portable controls, deterministic Plotly frames/sliders/buttons, standalone frame selection, and explicit JSON/HTML/static/unsupported export capability boundaries. Focused tests pass differentially in CPython and Sage.js, validate 2D/3D/panel cases and failure boundaries, lower 60 frames with 30,000 plotted points under the in-process 15-second guard, and render/animate with installed Plotly 3.7 in real Chromium.
risks: The current HTML graphics writer must call Plotly.addFrames for a payload containing frames; this lane prepares the full interactive figure but does not edit the shared exporter.

Frames intentionally materialize complete semantic states. Hard 64 MiB, 500-frame, 5,000,000-data-scalar, and one-hour caps prevent unbounded use, but a future delta encoding must preserve the same stable-ID and topology contract.
GIF, MP4, PDF, autoplay, loops, nested animations, dimensional changes, dynamic layer topology, and panel placement changes are explicit unsupported boundaries.

pnpm test:changed exercised the inherited 74-file main-2 delta and failed outside this lane in module-cache TYPE_CHECKING lowering and another worktree's symlinked native-cache state; it also correctly reported this new test absent from the central manifest. The focused suite, strict suite, architecture gate, full build, and Chromium smoke pass.
next_steps: Add src/lib/sagejs/plotting/animation.py to pyrightconfig.json strict include and test/plot-animation-panels.cjs to the integration tier in test/node-test-manifest.cjs.
Import the animation classes, errors, constants, stable_frame_id, lowering, capability, and export preparation helpers from src/lib/sagejs/plotting/__init__.py and append them to __all__.

The plot-spec package will become roughly 242 KiB of its 250 KiB budget after integration; raise the reviewed budget to at least 300 KiB or create a deliberate animation package boundary before integrating more parallel plotting modules.

Extend the shared HTML exporter to register figure.frames with Plotly.addFrames after Plotly.newPlot, and add SAGEJS_GRAPHICS_ANIMATION_FRAME_REQUIRED plus SAGEJS_GRAPHICS_ANIMATION_FRAME_INVALID to the TypeScript graphics export error-code contract before wiring static frame selection into Graphics.save.
